title: The Stolen Symphony
logline: An artist discovers their mentor's final symphony was stolen by a local archivist for commercial gain, and plots to steal it back for a free performance.

roles.description: Dramatic, intensely emotional, views art as sacred.
Snobby, views art purely as a financial asset.

public_situation: A highly anticipated premiere of a lost masterpiece is scheduled at the orbital music hall.
private_truth: The archivist stole the only copy from the artist's deceased mentor and copyrighted it.

beats.public_change: The archivist begins selling exclusive, exorbitantly priced tickets.

missions.reason: Needs the pilot to map the digital security layout of the hall's private databanks.
missions.private_fact: The artist intends to slice into the network and broadcast the symphony for free to the whole system.

beats.public_change: The archivist announces they have moved the data to a physical drive to prevent piracy.

missions.reason: Needs the pilot to retrieve the master data drive from a contact at the VIP lounge dock. They specifically need an independent pilot with a reliable ship.
missions.private_fact: The artist's mentor specifically asked that their last work never be sold.

beats.public_change: The premiere is hours away, and the archivist issues a massive reward for the missing drive.

missions.reason: The archivist contacts the pilot directly, offering double the reward to deliver the drive to them.
missions.private_fact: The archivist actually plans to delete the drive after the premiere to artificially inflate its value.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot holds the physical drive containing the masterpiece.

options.label: Give the drive to the artist to broadcast
Return it to the archivist for the reward
Destroy the drive so no one gets it

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot gives the drive to the artist.
resolutions.summary: The symphony is broadcast to every ship in the system. The artist is a hero, and the archivist is humiliated.
The premiere goes ahead. The archivist makes a fortune, and the artist is left devastated.
The masterpiece is lost forever. Both the artist and the archivist blame the pilot.

loose_threads.detail: The mentor's sudden death was certified by a physician on the archivist's payroll.
The musical notes of the symphony contain a cypher for a hidden offshore account.

radio_hooks: Tickets sell out for highly anticipated orbital premiere.
Local artist protests copyright claims over late mentor's work.

voice_direction.greedy_archivist: Snide, condescending, speaks very slowly as if to children.
voice_direction.passionate_critic: Loud, expressive, uses entirely too many adjectives.
